headline: Post Holdings posts $2.0 billion in Q4 sales as fiscal 2026 concludes
summary: Consumer packaged goods company Post Holdings reported net sales of $2.0 billion for its fourth fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2026.
why: Post Holdings is a major US food manufacturer operating across cereals, foodservice, and refrigerated retail products.

impacts.name: Post Holdings, Inc.
impacts.why: Reported fourth quarter net sales of $2.0 billion alongside its annual financial results.
